effect_description_eng:
＜Training＞ (In the main phase, by suspending this Digimon, place your deck's top card face down as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card. This effect can also activate in the breeding area.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By placing 1 card in your hand face down as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. It can't unsuspend in their next unsuspend phase.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
